βελέεσσιν: βέλος — shot, arrow, dart; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
βοτάνης: βοτάνη — pasture, grazing, fodder; fem. gen. sg., gen. with κορέννυμι: ’have one’s fill of grazing’
βόμβησε: βομβέω — make a deep ringing or booming noise; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβόμβησε)
δεῦτε: δεῦτε — come! (pl. imper.-like interjection of an old verb of motion; sg. δεῦρο)
δοάσσατο: δοάσσατο — it seemed; rare aor. 3 sg. (lemma disputed, akin to δοκέω), impersonal
κῆδος: κῆδος — care, concern; grief; neut. nom. sg.
μένεν: μένω — stay, stand firm, wait; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἔμενε)
πειρήσαιτο: πειράω — try, test, make trial of; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.: ’might test’
πεσοῦσα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having fallen’
πολίτης: Πολίτης — Polites, a companion of Odysseus (the common noun πολίτης is ’citizen’); masc. nom. sg.
στιβαρῆς: στιβαρός — stout, strong, solid; fem. gen. sg.
σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (= σύας), object: ’swine’
τετραμμένον: τρέπω — turn; perf. part. mid./pass. neut. nom. sg. (with σπέος): ’turned (toward)’
φρονέοντι: φρονέω — think, consider; pres. part. dat. sg. masc., agreeing with οἱ: ’to him as he considered’ · also agreeing with ἐμοί: ’to me as I thought’ (ἐμοὶ πυκινὰ φρονέοντι)
χύτο: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, passive sense (= Attic ἐχύθη): ’was poured’
ἀλέξασθαι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend oneself against; aor. inf. mid., + acc.
ἄνθος: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. acc. sg.
ἑοῖ: ἕ (reflexive) — him(self); epic dat. sg. ἑοῖ (= Attic οἷ), emphasized by αὐτῷ: ’with him himself’
ἔσχεν: ἔχω — hold, have; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, with ἂν in tmesis (ἂν … ἔσχεν = ἀνέσχεν ’held up, lifted’)
ἕπευ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕπου)
ἵκεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵκεθ’ = ἵκετο); augment orthographically indeterminate, ι-initial stem: ’has come’
ὁμηλικίη: ὁμηλικίη — those of the same age, age-mates; fem. nom. sg., used predicatively of one person: ’he is my age-mate’ · also predicated of a plural subject: πάντες ὁμηλικίη ’all of them of the same age’
ὁρμηθῆναι: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush forth; aor. inf. pass.: ’to rush out’
